title: SendGrid returns 202 but a recipient never gets mail because the address is suppressed
symptoms: 202 Accepted, then a dropped event instead of delivered
One user never receives password resets while others do
Credits consumed for messages that were never delivered
cause: Addresses on the bounce, invalid, spam report, global unsubscribe, or group unsubscribe lists are dropped after the API accepts the request, and each attempt still uses a credit. Bounces and spam reports keep suppressing until removed.
fix: Check the suppression lists for the address, remove it only when the user has fixed or confirmed it, and for required transactional mail set bypass flags narrowly.
affected: SendGrid v3 Mail Send and Suppressions API, as of 2026-10
